why: configFile is sent verbatim as config_yaml to CircleCI's own /compile-config-with-defaults endpoint (src/clients/circleci/configValidate.ts) and never parsed, executed, or written locally by this repo's code.

outputDir is validated with resolveSafeOutputDir/joinWithinDir/safeWriteFileSync (src/lib/file-output/safePaths.ts, used from src/lib/usage-api/getUsageApiData.ts) which canonicalizes symlinks, denies system dirs and hidden/node_modules segments, and opens with O_NOFOLLOW; the downloaded URLs come from CircleCI's own job-status response, not the caller.

the tool takes no outputDir/path parameter from the caller; when FILE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY is set it is an operator env var, and per-file names come from a regex-sanitized test.name (src/tools/getFlakyTests/handler.ts generateSafeFilename) that strips anything but [A-Za-z0-9_-].

csvFilePath is resolved through resolveSafeInputFile (src/lib/file-output/safePaths.ts) before fs.readFileSync in src/lib/usage-api/findUnderusedResourceClasses.ts readAndParseCSV, which rejects paths outside cwd/home/tmp roots and hidden/system segments including /etc.

projectSlug/branch/URLs only drive CircleCI API calls (remote-api-wrapper); outputDir, if provided, goes through resolveSafeOutputDir + joinWithinDir + safeWriteFileSync in src/lib/pipeline-job-logs/getJobLogs.ts formatJobLogs, the same guarded path-write primitive used elsewhere.

projectSlug/projectURL/workspaceRoot+gitRemoteURL/branch/jobNumber/pipelineNumber are only used to build CircleCI API requests in src/lib/pipeline-job-tests/getJobTests.ts; there is no filesystem, shell, or eval sink in this tool at all.

src/tools/getLatestPipelineStatus/handler.ts and src/lib/latest-pipeline/getLatestPipelineWorkflows.ts only resolve a projectSlug/branch and call CircleCI's pipeline/workflow APIs; no local sink of any kind.
src/tools/listArtifacts/handler.ts uses projectSlug/branch/URLs solely to call circleci.jobs.getJobArtifacts and formats the returned artifact URLs as text; the URLs are never fetched by this tool.

projectSlug/projectID/orgID/componentID/environmentID in src/tools/listComponentVersions/handler.ts are forwarded as path/query segments to CircleCI's own /deploy/* endpoints (src/clients/circleci/deploys.ts) on a fixed host; no local file, command, or eval sink exists.

the tool takes no input parameters at all (src/tools/listFollowedProjects/handler.ts / inputSchema.ts) and simply calls circleciPrivate.me.getFollowedProjects(); there is no caller-controlled data of any kind.

workflowId/workflowURL/fromFailed in src/tools/rerunWorkflow/handler.ts only select which workflow CircleCI's own rerun API acts on, scoped to whatever the caller's CIRCLECI_TOKEN can access; no local sink.

configContent and projectSlug/branch in src/tools/runPipeline/handler.ts are forwarded as the config.content field of CircleCI's own /project/:slug/pipeline/run API call (src/clients/circleci/pipelines.ts runPipeline); the config is compiled/executed by CircleCI's backend on the caller's own project, not by this process.

projectSlug/projectID/environmentName/componentName/currentVersion/targetVersion/namespace/reason/parameters in src/tools/runRollbackPipeline/handler.ts are packaged into a JSON body posted to CircleCI's own /projects/:id/rollback endpoint (src/clients/circleci/deploys.ts); the action executes against the caller's own CircleCI account/project, not locally.
